enter_sequence.text: Voss Compound vault. Cold light, colder ledgers. Every Sorrow had a price tag.

enter_sequence.speaker: VOSS
enter_sequence.text: You're interrupting a closed transaction. That costs extra.

defeat_sequence.speaker: VOSS
defeat_sequence.text: I sold the routes, the keys, the silence. Every Sorrow had a ledger line with my signature.

defeat_sequence.speaker: VOSS
defeat_sequence.text: Sentiment is a liability. The crew was inventory — until you stopped being profitable.

defeat_sequence.speaker: VOSS
defeat_sequence.text: Spare the asset and I transfer clearance. Liquidate me and the vault locks for good.

choice_sequence.prompt: Voss drops his datapad. What now?

spare_sequence.text: The Broker transfers clearance codes and vanishes into the compound tunnels.

execute_sequence.text: The vault seals shut. Voss won't broker another betrayal.
